component.name: SunVox
component.summary: Modular synthesizer and pattern-based music tracker

description.p: SunVox is a modular synthesizer and pattern-based tracker for composing and arranging music. Build sounds from synth and effect modules, edit patterns, and export audio.
This community package downloads the official, unmodified Linux release from WarmPlace at install time. SunVox is freeware for Linux; mobile editions are not included.

The Music folder is available for projects. To use another folder, grant it with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/projects ru.warmplace.SunVox; remove that grant with flatpak override --user --nofilesystem=/path/to/projects ru.warmplace.SunVox.
MIDI hardware access is optional: flatpak override --user --device=all ru.warmplace.SunVox. Remove it with flatpak override --user --nodevice=all ru.warmplace.SunVox.
